name: IBKR
description: IBKR lets agents read positions, balances, orders, and market data for the signed-in Interactive Brokers account. Each user signs in to their own Interactive Brokers account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize my current positions and their unrealized profit and loss.
What are my cash balance and buying power?
Show the latest quote and daily range for AAPL.

apps.name: IBKR
apps.description: Positions, balances, orders, and market data, over Interactive Brokers' MCP server with browser sign-in.
